title: Code of Conduct
text: Contributors users expected communicate respectfully, document technical claims, distinguish reproducible numerical evidence conjecture. Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory conduct accepted. Project maintainers may edit remove contributions violate standards. Methodological disagreement welcome. Reports identify estimator, critical-value convention, calibration mode, software version, reproducible example whenever possible.

title: Contributing
text: Please open issue proposing change covariance conventions, critical values, certification status semantics. Pull requests : include focused testthat coverage; preserve frozen Julia reference fixtures; pass R CMD check Windows, macOS, Linux; distinguish verified witnesses local-search candidates; never interpret numerical search failure global infeasibility.

code: set.seed(20260809) n <- 120 x1 <- rnorm(n) x2 <- rnorm(n) d <- 0.4 * x1 - 0.2 * x2 + rnorm(n) e <- (0.7 + 0.3 * abs(d)) * rnorm(n) y <- 0.55 * d + 0.25 * x1 - 0.15 * x2 + e fit <- lm(y ~ d + x1 + x2) benchmark <- benchmark_from_model(fit, "d", "x1", vcov = "HC1") benchmark #> Observed-control benchmark calibration #>   Name: x1  #>   Type / rank: scalar / 1  #>   Signed per-rank delta_L: 0.03733079  #>   Bounded magnitude b: 0.03733079 result <- robust_rv(   fit,   treatment = "d",   vcov = "HC1",   benchmark = benchmark,   n_starts = 8,   max_iterations = 20 ) result #> Benchmark-bounded robust RV  #>   Covariance: HC1  #>   Baseline decision: reject  #>   Status: EXACT_BOUNDED_RV / ADVERSE_ENDPOINT_PROTECTED_DIAGONAL  #>   Certificate: adverse_endpoint_equality  #>   Certified lower bound: 0.2092966  #>   Certified upper bound: 0.2092966  #>   Reported RV: 0.2092966  #>   Witness omega / robust t: 1.400975 / 1.980806  #>   Runtime: 0.119 seconds

title: RobustSandwichRV 0.1.0
text: Initial pure-R implementation. Added classical, HC0, HC1, CR0, CR1 scalar-confounder evaluation. Added protected-first, diagonal-first, full point-conditioned workflows. Added benchmark-bounded calibration certified lower upper bounds. Added scalar rank-normalized grouped observed-control benchmarks. Added explicit full-regression witness validation nested-band reuse. Added two-direction reduction arbitrary omitted-confounder blocks. Added frozen cross-language numerical fixtures, sensemakr comparison, sandwich covariance validation.
